question: In a certain code language, 'BIRD' is written as 'DKTF' and 'KITE' is written as 'MKVG'. How will 'EAGLE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BIRD' is written as 'DKTF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/740d1286a3841c019cc464aaf9696e59e92f4a149c3841ded8b5e983ffc347c1.png] 

And,

'KITE' is written as 'MKVG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3f1cd07bb1bc676ac2c8b94291aba3a6ab0f004c0390fa2caf1b5a5a29da312.png] 

Similarly,

'EAGLE' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0fd87396d9957eb40b7ef4ad02493652440a74ad76cfe1fbb4f21a45ff2cda6.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
